egress.terms: "No download charges*" with the asterisk resolving to "Fair usage policy applies. The allowed download amount equals to your stored amount." So egress is capped at exactly 1x stored capacity per month. This is the clearest example of 'no download charges' that is nonetheless metered.

chaining: S3 + Cloudflare works, but the 1x egress ceiling means a Cloudflare cache miss storm costs you the month.
limits_note: Egress = 1x storage per month. No minimum storage duration and no minimum file size — which is genuinely unusual and good for a churning hot set.
reliability_note: Finnish, small, transparent pricing page. No track record surfaced in any forum I searched.
